capabilities: Run any Obsidian command from a sidebar button
Organize buttons into named groups with custom ordering
Customize button icons with emoji, Lucide icons, vault images, URLs, or SVG
Restore deleted buttons or groups from deletion history
Find Command IDs via autocomplete in settings
extras: Roadmap lists unimplemented features (Reading Panel, automation triggers, settings dashboard), so the screenshots may show a version ahead of the current release. UI is English and Japanese, auto-detected from Obsidian's language setting.
motivation: Born from a personal need to reduce cognitive load and friction for users who prefer GUI-driven interaction over keyboard shortcuts and command palettes.
problem: Running commands normally requires digging through the command palette or memorizing shortcuts, which is slow for GUI-driven users and especially on mobile.
summary: Sidebar command launcher that runs any Obsidian command with one click from customizable button groups.
